observation.visible_scene: An outdoor food-cooking station, likely at a fair, under a yellow 'Jelen Pivo' umbrella. A large roasted animal head with two horns is fixed on a metal tripod spit over a bed of glowing coals. A dark metal drum stands at the right, emitting a thick plume of smoke. Several bystanders are present: a man in a grey jacket at the left edge, a man in a black vest and white shirt holding a thin rod/wire in the centre, and an older man partly hidden behind the smoke at the right. A person whose grey-sleeved arm reaches in from the top-right corner works on the meat with a knife-like tool near the right horn/eye.
visible_changes: The grey-sleeved arm/hand at top-right makes small, continuous adjustments, pressing and angling the tool against the meat around the base of the right horn throughout the excerpt; the action is already underway at the first frame and still ongoing at the last.
The smoke plume rising from the drum continuously billows and shifts shape, drifting upward and to the left over the scene.
The meat and the metal spit frame remain stationary; no rotation or translation of the roast is visible.
The bystanders stay in place with only minor posture/head movements (the vest man's hand holding the wire shifts slightly; the left man and right older man are essentially static).
The camera framing is fixed; the left structural edge, umbrella text and meat position do not change, so observed motion is object motion, not camera motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the spit rotates at other times outside this segment.
The exact purpose or outcome of the knife work on the meat.
The identity of the tool and the full body of the person whose arm reaches in.
uncertain_details: The hand's motion is subtle; it is unclear whether the tool is cutting, scraping or prodding.
Slight apparent movement of the meat's surface could be deformation of the roast or just changing light/smoke, not true motion.
